notes: Fixed a case where the YouTube audio-language picker could still mix streams from different dubs together and pick by bitrate on videos where no track was tagged as the original - reintroducing the exact bug this feature exists to prevent. Sponsor-segment auto-skipping could briefly stop working right after switching audio language - fixed. Picking an audio language that failed to switch (e.g. a network hiccup) no longer silently saves that choice as your preference.
